cells.tense: The pattern has surfaced, and the hand that chooses is, right now, holding it.
cells.act: hold the cloud of possible feeling without picking yet
cells.ask: When a choice shows up with a feeling already attached, hold that feeling for a few slow minutes without picking anything. The choice can keep waiting for you.
cells.core:
A pattern has finished assembling in you, and it is arriving as direction. You can see where it is going and say so plainly, without forcing it. What shows up here as a decision is not a flash of insight; it is a piece of seeing carried until it could be acted on, so the act lands in the same room as what showed it. A small call made on the back of this often turns out to have been the larger one, sitting quietly.

Let a little unreason in. Before acting, give what might be felt some room to show itself; hold the feeling steady for a minute or two before you sign off on the plan. A few minutes, or a day — the choice is small. You are not asked to be less exact, only to let one more kind of knowing arrive.
cells.sheetLine: The pattern is finished, so let a feeling in before you pick.
cells.verb: Reading the pattern before the rest of it arrives
cells.place: In the directed present, choosing the next move

cells.tense: The reading of the pattern will be complete, and the call will already fly before the rest of it arrives.
cells.act: decide it and act the same day, without explaining
cells.ask: Pick something on your list your analysis has already cleared, and do it today in silence, letting the doing carry it instead of a rehearsed reason.
cells.core:
Nothing has been shown to be unsound; the reading is fast and clean and it moves outward before it settles. A pattern gets recognized, and a conclusion is set in the same breath — sometimes before the pattern has had time to show what it is for. Where that runs ahead, the decision is not wrong, it just goes out past the room it belongs in. The clarity is real, and can be trusted more when it stays inside the case.

Make the next step without dressing it first. Take one action the reading has already reached, do it quietly the same day, and leave the explanation for later. You have a place in the movement; the point is that the movement does not need witnesses. In the doing, the authority becomes whole housekeeping: the thing you organized is still the thing you serve.

cells.tense: The choice was made some while ago, and the reasoning hand has been kept at the door since.
cells.act: cross over to the people it actually requires
cells.ask: Name what you are seeing to someone who is in the situation you are weighing, and hear what the living version says back to you.
cells.core:
The pattern is visible and being held in an old room. Nothing is being decided in the present — no call is being made now — and the pattern has been left beside a direction already chosen. What comes back as analysis, then, is not the state of things here; it is the shape of something that may no longer be running. There is no fault in it. The hand is simply in the past, and the present has not been signed yet.

More analysis will not bring it forward. Say what you have so far to someone who is actually in the situation you are weighing, as far as you can, and let their answer be the living version of the pattern. It is one small crossing, with a person, at the point of contact. That is how deliberation gets put back on its feet.

cells.tense: The pattern is being carried in the voice of an untouched observer, while the hand directing it is already writing.
cells.act: let yourself be drawn before you choose
cells.ask: On the next choice, say once to yourself or another that this direction is yours, then choose from there instead of from the reading of it.
cells.core:
What is happening here is a hand choosing direction and a story that says the direction was merely read. The pattern lands; the move gets made; the account of it sounds like reporting on conditions. So the part of you that chose gets called description, and the description walks away with what was done. The patterns are real — but seeing one is not the same as being pulled by it. Some are yours. Some are only conditions.

Say once, where you can, that a direction has been set here, and by you. Name the thing you followed or chose without smoothing it into a finding about how things are. One sentence does it. It is not a speech about noticing a pattern. It is a pattern returned to its owner.
